_comment_DockerAgents: Required only when AgentExecutor=docker-claude-cli. Binds to DockerClaudeAgentOptions.
_comment_CodexCli: Required only when a workflow role uses provider=codex. Rate-limit and env-var lists are operator-extensible; omit to use defaults.
_comment_ResourcePool: Required when both docker-opencode AND docker-claude-qwen appear as candidates against the same local llama.cpp server (the server runs --parallel 1 so concurrent requests fight for one slot). Tag both providers to a single shared resource with MaxConcurrent=1. Omit the whole section if you don't pair both Qwen-target providers.
